facts.says: Google Play genre EDUCATION; title PBS KIDS Video; summary: Educational TV shows, movies & songs for children. Stream, download, & watch.

PBS Kids Go! was an American educational television brand used by PBS for programs aimed at early elementary school kids ages 6 to 8, in contrast to the younger, preschool target demographic of PBS Kids.
